import os, errno
fd = os.open('/data/secret.txt', os.O_RDONLY)
try:
    print(os.read(fd, 3).decode())
    for mode in ['pre', 'post']:
        control = os.open('/control/' + mode, os.O_RDONLY)
        os.read(control, 1)
        os.close(control)
        os.lseek(fd, 3, 0)
        try:
            print(os.read(fd, 3).decode())
        except OSError as error:
            print(errno.errorcode[error.errno])
        control = os.open('/control/allow', os.O_RDONLY)
        os.read(control, 1)
        os.close(control)
        os.lseek(fd, 3, 0)
        print(os.read(fd, 3).decode())
finally:
    os.close(fd)
